title: Accounting and Tax Services for Family Doctors

rows.before: We incorporated a Medical Professional Corporation with a CPSO Certificate of Authorization, rolled the practice in on a section 85 election, built a monthly capitation and OHIP reconciliation workflow in QuickBooks Online, set a salary-and-dividend mix using the $500,000 small business deduction at 12.2%, and established an Individual Pension Plan the MPC deducts.
rows.after: We incorporated a Medical Professional Corporation with a CPSO Certificate of Authorization, rolled the practice in on a section 85 election, built a monthly capitation and OHIP reconciliation workflow in QuickBooks Online, set a salary-and-dividend mix using the $500,000 small business deduction at 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026), and established an Individual Pension Plan the MPC deducts.
rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).

rows.before: We purified the MPC of the passive assets, issued non-voting shares to her spouse within the TOSI rules on Form T1206, modelled dividends against her salary, and restored the full 12.2% small-business rate on active income while documenting the excluded-business tests.
rows.after: We purified the MPC of the passive assets, issued non-voting shares to her spouse within the TOSI rules on Form T1206, modelled dividends against her salary, and restored the full 11.2% small-business rate on active income while documenting the excluded-business tests.
rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).
